title: The Knight in the Panther's Skin

milestones.title: A queen and a mystery
milestones.body: Tinatin becomes ruler of Arabia. After the mysterious panther-clad knight appears and disappears, she sends Avtandil to find him.

milestones.title: Friendship at the cave
milestones.body: Asmat brings Avtandil and Tariel together. The knights become sworn brothers, and Tariel begins to explain his sorrow.

milestones.title: Tariel's earlier story
milestones.body: Nestan and Tariel love each other and oppose an arranged marriage. Tariel kills the bridegroom; Parsadan blames Davar, who sends Nestan away. Tariel begins his search.
milestones.sequence: Love and letters > marriage conflict > separation > search
milestones.extra: Tariel helps Pridon, who has seen Nestan at sea. Tariel's account brings the story back to the lonely knight at the cave.
milestones.cast: Tariel / Nestan / Parsadan / Davar / Asmat / Pridon

milestones.title: A promise kept
milestones.body: Avtandil reports to Tinatin, then leaves Arabia despite Rostevan's refusal. Shermadin keeps his household. Avtandil returns, helps restore Tariel's resolve, and renews the search.
milestones.cast: Avtandil / Tinatin / Rostevan / Shermadin / Tariel / Asmat

milestones.title: Following the sea road
milestones.body: Pridon helps Avtandil follow the maritime clue. Avtandil saves merchants from pirates and enters Gulansharo disguised as a merchant.

milestones.title: Fatman reveals Nestan's fate
milestones.body: Fatman tells Avtandil how she sheltered Nestan. Usen revealed the secret to the king; Nestan escaped, but was later captured and taken to Kadjeti.
milestones.sequence: Shelter > secret revealed > escape > capture > Kadjeti
milestones.extra: These are earlier events in Nestan's life, recounted now. The search finally has a destination.

milestones.title: Letters from Kadjeti
milestones.body: Fatman's messenger reaches Nestan. Her letters and a fringe from her veil bring her own words and news of the fortress. Avtandil sends notice to Pridon.

milestones.title: The allies reunite
milestones.body: Avtandil carries the letter and veil token to Tariel and Asmat. They find exceptional armor and travel to Pridon. Asmat stays in his household as the expedition departs.

milestones.title: The rescue at Kadjeti
milestones.body: Pridon, Avtandil, and Tariel discuss their plans. Following Tariel's plan, they attack the three gates together and free Nestan.

milestones.title: Homecoming and restoration
milestones.body: The companions thank their helpers. Avtandil is reconciled with Rostevan and marries Tinatin. Tariel and Nestan are united and establish their rule in India.
milestones.cast: The companions / their lovers / their helpers
